head: 5bba9a7fffa3b494b485341b51372452f196fad1
findings: Previous review blocker fixed: UpdateAsync(current,keyInfo) now checks the loaded snapshot and revision, aborts on stale/unknown schema, retains existing UserIds/metadata; 7 conflict cases including 2 pinned-old negative controls pass.

New distinct loss scenario remains: both sessions load revision0, server A later saves revision1, then server B (already active with more recent gameplay) attempts to save; B's UpdateAsync returns nil because expected revision0 differs. B's earned/spent progress is discarded on disconnect, despite all tests passing.

Official Roblox player-data guidance explicitly recommends session locking because a new session may load before an old session finishes saving. CAS cancellation prevents stale overwrite but does not guarantee saving the later session's progress.
blockers: P1: src/ToyWarsServer.server.lua loadProgress()/saveProgress(): two-server overlap A and B both load coins=200 revision0; A later saves 300 revision1; B plays to 500 and leaves; B's expected snapshot revision0 conflicts, UpdateAsync returns nil and persistent data remains 300. Add canonical two-session interleaving regression with newer session progress preserved, implement session ownership/locking at load or equivalently safe recovery without merging nonmonotonic coins by max; keep unknown schema and metadata protections.
limitations: No Roblox Studio/DataStore/multiplayer/mobile verification; offline mock only.
No autosave and failed DataStore requests may lose unsaved progress; keep documented, do not claim production durability.
